Thinking of the planning that would go into intentionally seeking out the DWFixer unlock makes my head hurt. You have to know that Operative is going to damage Fixer (she usually goes after the highest HP hero, right? So you have to be ready for a particular villain card draw) and will destroy him, and you have to wait until that turn to put out Bloody Knuckles (since it's only out for one turn), and you have to either never have used a tool or find a way to get rid of one (Fixer can't purposefully discard tools... I guess the Thief could take it?), AND you have to make sure that the Chairman doesn't kill Fixer first.

I'm not complaining; I know these things are supposed to be challenging! I am starting to think, though, that the "official" method for unlocking DWFixer is to wait until May 14 and put in the code. ;)
